j.summary: Redesigned Session Cards in Calendar View for Enhanced Attendee Experience with Overflow Indicator

v.deps: Child of EP-57118; relates to EP-57603. Shares one session card component with the All Day banner (EP-57098), so both specifications must agree (title line count aligned to 3 lines on 14 Sep). Built to the approved DLG G3 prototype (calendar-view-proto.vercel.app/dlg-g3). Risk: if the two story pages drift apart again, QA tests against contradictory criteria.
v.feature: Redesigned Session Cards in Calendar View with Overflow Indicator
v.impact: Attendees: instant readability for packed time slots with one-click access to all concurrent sessions. Organizers & Speakers: eliminates hidden or compressed sessions, giving equal visibility to all tracks.
v.notes: Deployed under parent EP-57118; FE by Oleksandr Zakablukov, QA by Olena Khromei.
v.rationale: Solves visual clutter when multiple overlapping or parallel sessions occur in the same time slot. Replaces cramped, illegible cards with a clean card design and a dedicated "+X more" overflow drawer.
v.why: For DLG: crowded time slots cram sessions into illegible cards; show at most 2 cards (4 in Day View) and a '+N' badge.
